confirmedNeedsFix.title: Theme preference regression is not stable across executed runs
confirmedNeedsFix.trigger: Run the ordinary root suite, or the isolated theme file in the observed loaded environment. The assertion at line 105 expects the second preference write within vi.waitFor; both observed runs timed out with one call.
confirmedNeedsFix.effect: The default root gate stops before application/Rust tests. A fresh serial root run passes without implementation/assertion changes, so the issue is validation stability; no deterministic product defect is established.
confirmedNeedsFix.suggestedNextAction: Execute B08-theme-preference-test-stability-shared. Isolate lazy theme loading from the asserted preference-write behavior and establish bounded, repeatable waits; preserve the original failure semantics. Load/cold imports are a hypothesis, not an established root cause.
